newsitem.title: FINLAND: LANNEN TEHTAAT SEES HIGHER 1997 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: LANNEN TEHTAAT SEES HIGHER 1997 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs and animal feed group Lannen Tehtaat said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to exceed the level in 1996, when it posted a 48.5 million markka profit before extraordinary items.
Net sales would exceed 900 million markka, it said.

"As a result of the larger volume and improved profitablility of frozen food operations, the financial perfomance is expected to rise slightly above the 1996 level," it said in a statement with its first tertial report.
Its January-April profit before extras rose 24 percent to 19.6 million markka from 15.8 million in the year-ago period.
